Write Differential Expression Results to CSV Files

Source: R/write_results.R
write_de.Rd

Saves the output of run_cluster_de into cluster-specific CSV files: the filtered DEGs and the full table of tested genes for each cluster.

Usage

write_de(de_list, outSubDir)

Arguments

de_list

The output of run_cluster_de: a named list whose elements each contain $degs and $tested data frames.

outSubDir

Character path to the output directory. Created recursively if it does not exist.

Value

invisible(NULL). Called for its side effect of writing CSV files.

Output files

  • <outSubDir>/<cluster>_DE_Results.csv: DEGs (skipped when a cluster has none).

  • <outSubDir>/<cluster>_tested_genes.csv: all tested genes.

See also

write_go for GO enrichment results.
